I used to be amused at old maps because they were so inaccurate. Now I appreciate them because they are so accurate. Mapping is incredibly difficult.
You should try it sometimes to see how you'd do. Map out your neighborhood without using google.

I used to rely on surveyors (before GPS). Yes I'm old. I was amazed at what they had to do just to get a single point on the ground accurate.

Find a known point. Shoot three azimuths to a guy holding a two meters bar to get distance and azimuth. Repeat.

Just amazing that map makers in the 1500s could do that.
A compass reading. One reading to the center of the bar for direction. Two readings to either end to determine the distance through triangulation.
